newsitem.title: JAPAN: Amway Japan climbs on solid earnings.
newsitem.headline: Amway Japan climbs on solid earnings.

text.p: Shares of Amway Japan Ltd continued to climb in active trading in the over-the-counter (OTC) market on Wednesday, supported by its recent solid earnings, traders said.
The share price of the household goods supplier stood at 5,000 yen at 0451 GMT, up from Tuesday's closing price of 4,660 yen. Volume was 129,500 shares.
"Amway is one of the issues that attracted buying after the Japan Company Handbook was published (by Toyo Keizai Inc) on September 17," said an analyst at a Japanese second-tier securities house.
The industry handbook, an updated version of which is published every quarter, showed the company's latest earnings results.

"Buying from foreign securities houses stood out. The issue was popular among foreign investors to begin with. Dealers also picked up the issue because of the active price movements," said a Japanese securities house broker.
